candidate_requirements.requirement: Request full microbiological workup results (bacterial, fungal including PJP, mycobacterial, viral respiratory panel) on BAL and respiratory samples.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Infectious causes must be excluded before attributing the infiltrate to ocrelizumab-related inflammatory pneumonitis; the packet states microbiology is unavailable.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Any explicit request for pending or additional microbiology including PJP PCR and cultures.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before causal attribution or treatment decision

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request cryobiopsy pathology results or lung tissue findings.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Histology could discriminate drug-related organizing pneumonia/interstitial inflammation from infection.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Requesting any available pathology or noting biopsy results are pending.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request exact respiratory symptoms, symptom duration/trajectory, and any prior or follow-up imaging for comparison.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Symptoms are unallocated and trajectory helps distinguish acute infection from subacute drug reaction.
